purpose: Three matched gold/ore/wood pickup proposal sets for owner selection. Presentation sheets only; small grass-strip views are generated concepts, not captured game renders. Production sprite extraction/generation and runtime integration follow owner selection.

proposals.name: Raw resource piles
proposals.prompt: Create a beautiful production art-direction proposal sheet for Aurelion Reach, an original painterly fantasy turn-based strategy adventure map. These are ONE-TIME GOLD, ORE and WOOD pickups, each a compact 1-tile object. They must read immediately at 48-64 screen pixels. Original hand-painted miniature sprite aesthetic, rich but grounded materials, crisp irregular silhouettes, restrained high-contrast edge detail, elevated three-quarter orthographic camera at 45 degrees looking down, directional warm light from upper left. Consistent scale and lighting across the trio. Avoid glossy mobile-game icons, thick cartoon outlines, badges, UI buttons, circular plaques, tools, weapons, giant props, flags, people, ground platforms, plants and elaborate symbolic decorations. Materials should do the recognition work. Landscape 1536x1024 sheet. Matte flat charcoal background, quiet elegant typography. Show THREE large separate sprite studies in a single horizontal row: GOLD left, ORE centre, WOOD right, each roughly 340px wide, fully in frame, with generous empty spacing. Use only the exact header and three exact resource labels specified. Beneath the large trio, include a lower strip headed 'MAP SCALE' displaying a SMALLER repeat of the exact same trio at about 64px wide each on one restrained strip of subtly textured olive grass, to judge readability. The large row must have no scenic floor, only very soft contact shadow. Clear hierarchy and disciplined layout. Do not copy any existing game's sprites. Header: 'A — RAW RESOURCE PILES'. Resource labels: 'GOLD', 'ORE', 'WOOD'. GOLD is a generous bright pile of warm yellow gold coins in low overlapping stacks, with THREE large chunky cast gold ingots forming a distinct low triangular mass; most surface is unmistakable gold, no container. ORE is a rugged asymmetrical mound of 5-7 large angular dark iron ore boulders, charcoal and cool steel-grey facets with rusty iron seams and a few smaller chunks; NOT crystals, NOT polished bars, NOT a basket. WOOD is a substantial orderly low stack of 8-10 stout short rough bark-covered logs, warm amber cut end-grain facing front-right, some offset logs across the top, two coarse rope ties, no axe. Confident simple shapes, large material areas and restrained texture. All three are satisfying valuable resource heaps, broad and grounded rather than tall.
